desc.zh: 从一个安全出口推导逆向胜负传播，区分尚未证明与平局。
desc.en: Derive backward win propagation from a safe exit, and distinguish unknown from draw.

complexity: O(nE) time; O(n²) auxiliary space, E = undirected edges

concepts.name: Retrograde game solving
concepts.description: Propagate one winning exit or exhaust all losing exits.

concepts.name: Residual draw states
concepts.description: Prove draws after the forcing-win queue is exhausted.
